tasks.gr9-transformations-t4: Topic: Transformation Geometry. Cover translations, reflections, rotations, and enlargements on coordinate axes. Ask Grade 9 learners to describe transformations precisely, use coordinates to specify transformation details (centre, scale factor, direction), verify results mathematically, explore symmetry and congruence, and analyse which transformations preserve shape and size.
tasks.gr9-3d-objects-t4: Topic: Geometry of 3D Objects. Cover properties of solids (faces, edges, vertices), classification of 3D objects, nets of common solids, and spatial reasoning. Ask Grade 9 learners to count and describe faces, edges, and vertices, match solids to nets, apply Euler's formula, classify solids accurately, and visualise 3D shapes from different perspectives.
tasks.gr9-data-handling-t4: Topic: Data Handling. Cover data collection, representation using graphs and tables, and summary measures (mean, median, mode, range). Ask Grade 9 learners to choose appropriate representations, calculate summary measures, compare data sets, identify outliers and bias, discuss data spread, and critique graph choices for accuracy and clarity.
tasks.gr9-probability-t4: Topic: Probability. Cover simple and compound events, tree diagrams and two-way tables, mutually exclusive and independent events, and relative frequency. Ask Grade 9 learners to calculate probabilities of single and compound events, interpret probability notation, explain likelihood in context, use tree diagrams correctly, and compare theoretical and experimental probabilities.
